usage: The word 獸 (sau3) is used to refer to beasts or wild animals in general.
It can be used to talk about animals that are fierce, wild, or untamed.
You can find 獸 combined with other words to describe specific animals or animal types.
It’s mostly used in formal contexts, stories, or when emphasizing the animal’s wild nature.
